Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
March 11, 2014
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Harlan Dunn, Member of Oak Hills Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session

Proclamations recognizing two of the recipients of the 2013 City of Vista Employee Awards:
* Natalie Jacobs, Employee of the Year
* Steve Glaudini, Manager of the Year
CONSENT CALENDAR

Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)

Engineer's Reports for Fiscal Year 2014/15 Levy of Assessments (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , Landscaping and Lighting District No. 1;

DISCUSSION
D1.
Bargain Basement Store Regulations (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
General Plan Amendment and Special Use Permit Findings (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider amendments to the General Plan regarding special use permits ; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , amending the Land Use and Community Identity Element of the General Plan.; and
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2014-, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 18.74.120 of the Vista Development Code Concerning Special Use Permits."
PH2.
2012 Regional Transportation Improvement Program (RTIP) Amendment (CC)
1.
Continue, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to receive public comment on a list of transportation projects eligible to use transportation sales tax (TransNet) funds; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , adopting the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for FY 2013 through 2018.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
